name: Deathlock
source:
In this visual novel you follow the story of Dall, a youngling of faith trying to help their friend, Tristan, to lift a curse of undeath. However, as the relationship between the two deteriorates, Tristan's humanity wanes and Dall's faith wavers, can Dall make it out of the situation alive?

[From [url=https://ylvanaar.itch.io/deathlock]Itch.io[/url]]
